book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Luk girumalena

content: Obu kotu apanawa surakauidasadia gagalowa babawa
Ema aupe Iesu wawe alala rauparintoipe os waimoipona menasano baiwa obu dea gagalowa babawa mampe mo waeuwamodie.
Ita me wane wanase, “Bola debama dea bedewe kotu apanawa wandie. Me nolaleidie wandie bedewe mai God sawaleipe ita do apanawa mai umanau da waipe, dia.

Tane bola sa bedewe obu dea wandie kainokaino kotu apanawa sa mampe iedie meba iririwa itudia sausapie euda osowe itupia menasadie. Ita me kainokaino me diedi wadiase, ‘Ne saunee baina badowa gagaloitaa emalawoana apanawa mampe, kadiwa mainawo segalepia sawa.’

Me obu sa kainokaino iririsadio etedie mai sausaipe ba gagalowa wawawa menasaipe, dia, dabualeidie edie. Obu sa mapo os me mampe badowa iririleidio baiwa kotu apanawa meba wane wanase, ‘Ne nolantedine wainedine bedewe mai God sawanteipe ita apanana mai umanau da waipona, dia.

Tane obu ema walama uduudu iririwa mampe surakauidanedio etena dabualeno wainedina. Me walama daumawa iririneampe mala osowe itunepia sawa me sausapo kotuwa dodomanalepi. Ita me wampidewae iririna epio ne nuana topi.’”
Iesu gagalo babawa ema wana ipawaida wadewasalene wanase, “E kotu apanawa sa kadiwa gagalowa etalana mampe aten wadana!

Obu kainokaino kotu apanawa iririsadie surakauidasadio baiwa me mai iririwa etapadabue epona, dia, tane me iririwa rua sausano kotuwa dodomanalen. E inseilana God sonabamodia apanawa mida tadina ita walama rauparintoie iririsaie os waimoia iririu walama andoido sipoamopi, ba iririu etadabualepie emopie mai insamopi, ba? Sa dia!

God sonabamodia apanawa tauwadea iririu ruawalepie saumopio inantopu, mai dabuamopie emopi, dia. Tane Apana Otopa kotu awa wisepia walamawe apana sumanaintompe waimompo dommopi, ba di waimompo ewamopi?”
Parisi ita takis manewa tamalala rauparintoia gagalou babawa
Iesu epe waeuwaleidio asisulala isiwa eneie inseia mo dewau dodomanaida baiwa sosou uduudu ituaisimoie lai. Mo epe inseia osowe Iesu gagalo babawa ema diamone wanase,
“Walama dea Parisi dea ita takis manewa tamalala dea God duwe raupari awa odane antoiena.

Ita Parisi apanawa raupari baiwa enenwisene meba segaralene God diene wanase, ‘Mako God, ne dewana euda os dewamodine apana uduudu aimona baiwa auwadewasaedina. Ne wiki ruawantedine walama nata bedewe idintedine rauparintedine os wainedina. Ita do mane ba puraiwa ba dima uduudu wadedine osowe wainedina moawa eiawa anaanamba wadia rua pulontedine os wainedina, mai walama da eipona, dia. Ne mai mo poiwaau, kadi daitada dewalala, ita ninalala ruau, ba takis manewa tamalala emanta enedie rauparileidia rua wainipona, dia.’

Tane takis manewa tamalala apanawa raupari baiwa mai God duwa bedeweido odapona, dia, me God sawalene awoa du moape enene rauparileidie. Tane me mai mo dewau rua pisiwape rauparilepona, dia. Me dunelene enedie kadi dewasana insene nuawa pareleno amatumba epedie os rauparileidie wadiase, ‘Mako, ne kadi dewalala wainedina, nuaparenaite kadina insadabuamoa!’

Ne ulaipa dialedina, God takis manewa tamalala apanawa raupariwa sipoasane kadiwa insadabuamono God mampe dodomanalene God duwa ene bolawe alen. Tane Parisi apanawa rauparileidie mai God mampe dodomanalepona, dia, me di ene alen. Apana mida muba segarau waie ituposintoie waimoia God mo ituaisimopi. Tane mo mida muba ituaisintoie God sawantoie waimoia God ituposimopie ionomopi.”
Apana otooto kerakera otamoie Iesu mampe wimoio sau euda osouwo itude
Ema aupe apana isiwa otooto kerakera otamone Iesu mampe wimoiena me witapa osouwo itupie sau euda wanamopia baiwa. Wawe alala mo epe dewantoio ewamone apana onau wane bodamoiena.

Mo apana bodamoio Iesu otooto kerakera apamono mampe wimoieno wawe alala diamone wanase, “Otooto kerakera mai onau wane bodamona, emono ne mainawo wimpu, ipawa God gonaawa otooto kerakera ema ruau mo mampoa.
Ne ulaipa dialedina, me mida oto kerauda rua nuawa wadaaubala me God gonaawa bedewe odepia rua, tane mida mai oto kerauda ruawalepia, me mai God gonaawa bedewe odepi, diaida.”
Maura apanawa Iesu mampe wisene inalepia waitarawasade
Iesu mo sau euda osouwo itune diasane enedio apana onionialala dea eboeboua me mampe wisene waitarasane wanase, “Debamamba, e euda apanawa, dianeawo atenteapa ne dima dewasape inawinakasala donsapa?”
Iesu sipoasane wanase, “E dima baiwa ne euda apanawa dianeiana? God meba os euda, mai mida da, dia.
E anaana wineia ateitena ruauitona, sa ipa: Mai ninaitaa, mai soa da bosaa, mai poitaa, mai kutunte lagaitaa, mamaa ita inaa do oniadewasamone aiau ruauitona.”
Maura apanawa epe etene Iesu sipoasane wanase, “Debamamba, ne oto keraudanawo ita tauma anaana sa uduudu ruauntene dewamonatuwan.”

Me epe wadio Iesu etene diene wanase, “E dea os eanosidena dewasaa: Puraiwaa uduudu manawo wineia gimaramoatue manewa wadee nuaparelala wanamowo uboo e mauraa debamalepi. Ema dewasae aupe wine ne waroronea.”
Me Iesu epe dieno etene puraiwawa uaraia osowe wandia insamone inainamba aisidene nuapareidalene enedie.
Mape Iesu me ewene diene wanase, “Maura apanawa God gonaawa bedewe odaodawa badowaida!
Pue debama kamel selau nagawa bedewe mai odepia rua, dia. Deawaa, maura apanawa insaisawa puraiwawa osowe itudie wandia God gonaawa bedewe odaodawa badokadilen!”
Mo asisulala Iesu gagalowa ema etane waitarasane waienase, “Ambi ipa epe Iesu God gonaawa bedewe odaodawa badokadilena wade? Apana da inalepia intawa da winede, ba dia?”
Ita Iesu mo waitarau sipoasane wanase, “Apana mampo mai inantopona intawa da wineipona, dia, tane God mampe inta wadaaubala winede.”
Pita aia ema etene nuawa pola wano Iesu diene wanase, “No dewa uduudu mainimboa emotatue e waroroeite do leitana, tauma inawinakasala bedewe odata, ba dia?”

Iesu Pita waitarawa etene mo uduudu diamone wanase, “Ne ulaipa dialedina, mida me duwa, ba me manainapa, ba nonopa, ba gombawaida, ba obampaida emontue God gonaawa baiwa nolaleidia dima me emona rua God me eiasampe wanompo wadompe waimpa, mai dia. Ita do walama ando iedia bedewe me inawinakasala donsapi.”
Iesu bolepia umanawa wawe alala osowe diaimaamode
Ema aupe Iesu wawe alala 12 diamono mampe wimoieno diamone wanase, “No odate antitana Ierusalemwa, sape dima uduudu God perowetawa Apana Otopa mampe segantopua umanawa girumantoiena ulaipantopu.
Me apanawaida dabuasapue Rom gabemaniu mamposapuo insaisau rua me mampe dewasapu. Mo me wasi kadiwa daitada wampe diompe wawakadikadisampe, seseisampe ita tai gedaragedaraua mampe epompe ita bosapu.
Ita walama natadeawo me bo bedewe enepiwisepie waimpa.”
Iesu bolepia gagalowa wawe alala diaimaamodio etane tane gagalowa ipawaida mai atendewantopona, dia. God walama sawo mo insaisau bodeno mai atentopona Iesu dima umanawa wadie.
Iesu apana emawa potawa inasade
Iesu wawe alala do Ierusalemwa antoie into bola Ieriko mampentoio apana emawa potawa inta waiwe waine dima menasadia rua iririwaleidi wandie.
Apana uaraia wimone me tampeinta antoio daubu etene apana waitaramone wanase, “Dima segaleidio apana uarantoi?”
Mo me diane waienase, “Nasaret Iesuwa wisene aleide.”
Apana emawa potawa aia ema etene mukama wane wanase, “Iesu, Dawid Otopa, nuaparenaite saunea!”
Apana bautantone antoia me epe wadio etane me dainalepona baiwa onawa waie. Tane me onawa waio etendabue mukaidalene wane wanase, “Iesu, Dawid Otopa, nuaparenaite saunea!”
Ita Iesu me sau baiwa wadio etene aindo enene apana diamona me banlepue mampe wimpu. Mo me wana rua emawa potawa banlene Iesu mampentoio me apana sa waitarasane wanase,
“Dima e manawo dewasapaa meneede?” Apana emawa potawa sipoasane wanase, “Debamamba, ne sala ewapaa menanedio iririntedina!”
Mape Iesu me diene wanase, “Inaite sala ewaa, eba sumanaia inaen.”
Me epe wadio apana emawa potalena inaleno sala ewene nuaeu debama do God wadaposisane Iesu warorosano do antoiena. Tane apana uduudu dima segalena ewane do God wadaposisane ionosaiena.
